models.name: todo_users
models.description: Main user entity for the todo application. Each record represents a unique authenticated user who can create, read, update, and delete their own todo items. This table is the foundation of the authentication system and is referenced by todo_user_sessions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for user authentication. Must be unique across the system.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographic hash of the user's password. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Used for audit and sorting purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated. Automatically updated on changes to user profile.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When null, user account is active. When set, account is marked for deletion.

models.name: todo_user_sessions
models.description: Session records for authenticated todo users. Each session represents a single active connection from a user. Sessions are managed automatically by the authentication system and are not directly manipulated by users.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who owns this session. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: The IP address from which the session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL of the connection that created this session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referrer URL that led to this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires or is terminated. Null means the session is still active.

models.name: todo_items
models.description: Stores personal todo items for authenticated users. Each item represents a discrete task with lifecycle tracking from creation to completion. Follows strict 3NF normalization with no denormalization.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this todo item. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: text
plainFields.description: The text content of the todo item. Maximum length is 500 characters as specified in business rules.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the todo item. Must be 'pending' or 'completed' as per business rules.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created. Cannot be null as required by system.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was marked as completed. Nullable, as items start in 'pending' status and may never be completed.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for record retention policies. Allows for logical deletion without data loss.
